thread:
Aisha Patel: Urgent — MercuryPay sent a CAIQ + bespoke security questionnaire, due EOD Fri. They also report intermittent 401s for production API keys and a billing mismatch on the last invoice. Need owners and repro steps. /cc @Jon Reyes @Carmen Liu :exclamation:
Jon Reyes: On it. Can you paste the customer's org id, sample request ids, and the timestamps? We should check auth service and key rotations. Also are they on Dedicated or Hosted?
Aisha Patel: Org: mercurypay-prod, contact: security@mercurypay.com. They say errors around 2026-03-12 14:20–14:40 UTC; sample req IDs: req_01FHJ2a9, req_01FHJ9b3
Carmen Liu: I'll take CAIQ + KMS/HSM answers. For HSM — we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS + optional CloudHSM wrapping. I'll draft a matrix of supported HSM providers + what telemetry we can provide. ETA tomorrow AM.
SecurityBot: CAIQ canonical: https://internal-redwood.s3/caiq/2025-caiaq-v3.pdf — use template 'redwood-caiq-v3' from the compliance drive to fill.
Tom - Support: Re billing — can you share the invoice number? For charge breakdown run: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices?org=mercurypay-prod"```
Jon Reyes: Re prod 401s — quick repro steps for us: 1) which SDK/version; 2) token type (personal/service); 3) any recent key rotation. Meanwhile I'll tail auth logs: ```sudo journalctl -u auth-service -f | grep "mercurypay-prod" | grep 401``` — need request ids to match.
Carmen Liu: Also: audit log retention defaults differ by deployment. For Hosted we surface 90-day logs in console; Dedicated/Private have configurable retention and export APIs. I'll pull config for mercurypay-prod and prepare an export of the last 90 days (signed manifest + hashes). If they need longer retention we can propose archived exports to S3.
Aisha Patel: Customer specifically asked for: CAIQ sections on data retention/deletion, KMS/HSM architecture diagram, proof of audit log integrity (hashes/timestamps), and a statement on who can access keys and logs.
Jon Reyes: Action items: Jon -> reproduce auth errors & collect request IDs (ETA 2h). Carmen -> CAIQ + KMS writeup + audit export (ETA 24h). Tom -> billing verification and invoice breakdown (ETA 4h). Aisha -> coordinate customer comms and confirm deployment type with them.
Aisha Patel: I'll send an interim ack to the customer within 1 hour and tell them we have owners assigned. I'll attach this thread plus ticket once created. Thanks team :thumbsup:
